text:
mike: heads up — we need GPU capacity in southeastasia for a customer POC next week. target SKUs: ND40rs_v2 (A100) x4 and NC24r_v3 (V100) x8. quota is currently 0. can someone open quota + capacity reservation requests? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devon: can you paste the subscription id and run the usage check? i’ll draft the support request once we have outputs

mike: sub: 6f3e1a2b-9d4f-4c1d-8b2a-12c3d4e5f678
cmd i ran:
```
az vm list-usage --location southeastasia --query \"[?contains(name.value, 'Total Regional vCPUs') || contains(name.value, 'Standard ND') || contains(name.value, 'Standard NC')].{name:name.value, currentValue:currentValue, limit:limit}\" --output table
```
output (snip):
Standard ND family (ND40rs_v2) currentValue: 0 limit: 0
Standard NC family (NC24r_v3) currentValue: 0 limit: 0
Public IPs currentValue: 42 limit: 50

anya: oof, limit=0 usually means SKU not enabled in subscription/region. we need an explicit quota increase + capacity reservation request. i'll help draft text for the SR.

devon: copying suggested SR body — please confirm and i'll open it: 
"Dear Microsoft support, we are requesting quota increases and capacity reservation for the following VM SKUs in subscription 6f3e1a2b-9d4f-4c1d-8b2a-12c3d4e5f678 in Southeast Asia (southeastasia):
- Increase quota for Standard ND family (ND40rs_v2) to 8 vms (target 4 for POC, 8 headroom)
- Increase quota for Standard NC family (NC24r_v3) to 8 vms
- Reserve capacity (capacity reservation / quota commit) for ND40rs_v2: 4 vms from 2026-04-01 for 1 month (request expedited)
Please escalate to TAM; this is time-sensitive for a customer POC. Thank you."

arjun: also ask them to check "subscription-level VM family quota" vs "regional availability". sometimes Azure sets limit 0 if SKU isn't registered. request both quota increase and quota enablement. mention prefer zonal reservation in zone 1.

mike: confirmed, good to go. please include cost center (POC-ENG-2026) and billing contact tina@redwood.com.

devon: opened SR: SR#202604-987654321. included TAM escalation request. support link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/HelpAndSupportBlade/overview

azure-bot: Support request created SR#202604-987654321. Current status: New. Estimated initial response: 24-48 hours.

tina: FYI — if they want capacity reservation up-front there may be a short-term commit fee. i’ll ask finance for quick approval if support confirms price. :money_with_wings:

mike: ran a quick fallback check — australiaeast shows ND40rs_v2 quota 2 available, but not enough for POC. if Azure can only do quota increase (not immediate reservation) we should plan cross-region fallback + test replication.

anya: suggested SR update: add fallback region australiaeast and request any available pre-provision options. that makes the TAM escalate easier.

devon: support replied (auto): "Investigating. For quota increases that involve new SKUs we may require subscription enrollment and 72–96 hours to provision. For capacity reservation, please confirm payment/commit terms." they asked for signed PO if we want expedite.

arjun: action items: 1) tina to confirm PO/finance 2) devon to push TAM for expedite 3) mike to test cross-region images 4) anya to add australiaeast to SR as fallback.

mike: on it — i'll start image copy to australiaeast tonight and share runbook. will update here. :rocket:

devon: tracking: SR#202604-987654321 — I'll post updates. please react to this thread for any blocker. :thumbsup:
